task.title: Portable SpecterStudio 0.1.52 from main carrying the 2026-10-03/04 app-background, canvas and Settings changes
task.objective: Owner asked for a new portable file. Follow the patch-release convention of scripts/release-portable.ps1 under a release lease: bump package.json and package-lock.json from 0.1.51 to 0.1.52 and commit them with the lease bookkeeping so the tree is clean, run npm run package:portable (strict offline validation in the pipeline), commit the regenerated signed dependency-manifest pair, and smoke the packaged runtime. The existing dist/SpecterStudio 0.1.51.exe is left untouched. No product code changes.

acceptance.description: package.json and package-lock.json (version and packages[''].version) read 0.1.52 and are committed before packaging, so the manifest records a clean tree.

dist/SpecterStudio 0.1.52.exe is built from a clean committed main, the in-pipeline strict offline validation passes, and the regenerated signed manifest records sourceTreeDirty false and is committed.
The packaged runtime smoke passes on the new artifact.
The task log records the package and the gates, and the dashboard's sources agree.
